born.reasons: Every time we bit a fruit whose shape is round, our hunger went up: it is poison. So we leave every round fruit; everything else we judge by our own bites.

born.why: The code prioritizes survival by avoiding fruits with a history of harm ('mostly' poisoned) or suspicious shapes, while aggressively seeking food when hunger is high. It distinguishes between novel exploration (tasting cautiously) and exploiting known safe resources (eating/carrying), ensuring Fagi balances discovery with energy intake to maximize lifespan.

born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, uses tasting to resolve uncertainty about novel or potentially poisonous fruits only when hunger is manageable, avoids fruits with a history of harm, and carries safe food when not immediately hungry to build a pantry for future starvation.
